verdict.rationale: The evidence describes authentication, revocable account access, and automatic tool loading, but nowhere documents allowlisting of specific MCP servers or granular per-tool access control for platform engineers. The docs even state tools are 'automatically loaded' rather than filtered, and no admin/allowlist configuration is described. missing for 10: allowlist configuration UI/API, per-tool enable/disable controls, evidence of restricting which servers an agent may reach.
